summary: Synchronously drain and return a MutationObserver's queued MutationRecord objects.

target.notes: Clone/return the current record queue in order and empty the observer's queue without invoking the callback.

caveats: Record objects must retain DOM node identity and oldValue semantics.

tests.name: returns queued record
tests.input: const n=document.createElement('div'); const m=new MutationObserver(()=>{}); m.observe(n,{attributes:true}); n.setAttribute('x','1'); console.log(m.takeRecords().length);

tests.name: second take is empty
tests.input: const n=document.createElement('div'); const m=new MutationObserver(()=>{}); m.observe(n,{attributes:true}); n.setAttribute('x','1'); m.takeRecords(); console.log(m.takeRecords().length);
